intro.text: An officer in Kholinar whose second in command is Lieutenant Noromin.
Captain of the Seventh Platoon of the Kholinar Wall Guard.

items.text: At dinner, Deedanor gaped at Kaladin's bold questions to Azure. When the Fused attacked the wall, one pinned him with her lance and threw him off, and he died in the fall; Kaladin chose not to risk his powers to save him.
